title: Completions asked as one types: entering made interactive without a terminal view
note: The author, 2026-11-13: argenv can let completions be regenerated on the fly, making the entering of a command itself interactive. What it stands on is already open here: a list whose members are known only at runtime (argenv-open-lists) - the id of an existing row is such a list.
